name: pdk-pandas-genomics-dataframe
instr:
A partner site has started sending us PLINK filesets made with PLINK 2, and pandas_genomics doesn't cope. A sample is in /data/partner/: cohort.bed, cohort.bim and cohort.fam, plus cohort.afreq, the plink2 --freq report they ran on it.

io.from_plink fails on their files. Once it loads, every genotype call should be the one PLINK reads from the .bed, with allele2 as the reference allele (allele1 with swap_alleles=True), and df.genomics.maf should agree with their report. Family, sample and parent IDs in the index must be text exactly as in the .fam, and chromosomes the text from the .bim. Sex, the Case/Control phenotype, categorical_phenotype=False and max_variants should keep working as they do now. A .bed whose size doesn't fit the .fam and .bim should raise ValueError.

We send QC'd frames back with io.to_plink, for example after dropping samples or running filter_variants_maf. PLINK has to read what it writes as the same samples, IDs, sex, case/control status (missing as -9) and calls, for any number of samples. A frame loaded with from_plink and written straight back should give the same .bed bytes, and a .fam and .bim that PLINK reads the same way as the originals (the centimorgan column aside).

A few tests in /app/tests were written against the current calls; update them as needed. The package should stay black formatted, as CI checks. There's no network, and PLINK isn't installed.
